cross-reference.answer: I read §2002:9.2.4. It is word for word §2023:9.2.4, including 'The implementor shall specify any keys that change the position of the cursor', so the scope is unchanged. The screen facility is declined at --std 2002 under §2002:B.3 item 1 with §2002:3.1.5 (the reader's licence-2002), so nothing a 2002 program can show changes.
